Rejected candidate1: generated-rest-face quality mismatch locked most nominal-radius Move motion near zero; parent requested stop after12 completed cases; expected Runtime.evaluate timeout follows deliberate owned Browser.close, see early-stop.json
Focused corrected-metric probe passed outbound geometry/GPU/history; correctness-only because native work was concurrent
Earlier native candidate failed the proposed >2-radius tiny-normal extension gate; not relabeled as a pass, not used for final-source geometry measurements.

limitations: No ZBrush comparison, output equivalence or feature parity claim.
Synthetic trusted CDP pointer events in owned headless Chrome. Native GUI, physical mouse/pen/tablet pressure, and input-to-photon latency remain unverified.
Frame gaps and release-to-GPU-readback probes are scoped host scheduling observations; no GPU timer query or physical display latency.
Safety guards deliberately limit very long tiny-radius pulls. Final PNGs show small shallow local edits, not unrestricted stretching.
Existing folds in the unchanged supplied user model remain; no automatic damage repair or global self-intersection proof.
Fresh repeated eight-contact sequence has seven effective history states; one contact produced no change.
Mirror errors here measure eligible exact original-vertex source pairs; new-vertex correspondence and general posed symmetry are separate gates.
Final release probes wait incremental0/200/800ms; exact cumulative timestamps and raw pointer events are in the immutable raw receipt.
Raw probe.at is captured before gpuDigest begins. The 2.7–8.1 ms aggregate measures DOM pointer-up to probe-start, not GPU readback completion, upload latency or display latency.
requestAnimationFrame observations come from an independent instrumentation callback and include drag plus post-release idle. They do not measure sculpt-render FPS.
GPU/save equality covers packed float32 position, normal, mask and color vertex-buffer bytes. The GPU index buffer was not independently captured; saved topology and history were checked separately.

native_diagnostic.scope: CPU-only independent diagnostic of frozen OBrush Move sources. No browser, input latency, native GUI, ZBrush parity or global self-intersection/repair claim.
native_diagnostic.outcome: Metric patch fixes the recorded-grab near-freeze. Four preregistered movement-range failures remain; this is not a full pass of the movement-range sweep.

contract.scope: Diagnostic thresholds fixed before running both frozen variants. No performance, browser or ZBrush parity claim.

native_diagnostic.numerical_method: Recorded top-origin pixels/camera reconstructed with production f32 formulas and frozen core raycast. Native f32/libm may differ in low bits from WASM; this is not a claim of bit-identical internal browser hit. All-vertex displacement compares against exactly exposed prepared rest positions; active faces have at least one nonzero target influence.
native_diagnostic.build_method: Copied brush/refinement sources are unchanged. Only copied lib wrapper adds read-only accessors to private rest geometry and influence weights. Standalone package adapters pin original locked dependency versions. Final proposed run uses its own fresh target directory.

retained_setup_checks.description: Preliminary helper used direct tangent rather than retaining the exact f32 FOV atan/tan expression. Retained; matched final comparison uses the corrected common helper.
Invalid copied-package shared-target reuse was detected from logs; identical output did not test changed algorithm. Rebuilt into fresh variant target before conclusions.

record.scope: Exact recorded camera inputs recomputed with native f32 math; related runtime internal hit was not logged, reconstructed f64 hit/target used only as tolerance witnesses; no ZBrush comparison or universal long-pull range claim

result.limits: Four stronger range thresholds remain separately failed in the independent28-case audit; these tests establish only the declared1mm utility floor.

recorded_native_tests.final_source_note: The frozen recorded-test receipt preceded a Clippy-only literal precision correction. Before and after literals have identical f32 bits; all twelve final Move tests pass within the final 156-test workspace run pinned by move-quality-build.json.
